# Connected Clause

Named actions connect to native sources and callable workflows. Bindings supply action connections and declared property values, with type defaults when provided. Workflows can select a configured party or channel and require the exact reviewed document version.

Use `parameters.conditionGroups.<id>` to apply one `condition` expression to the named `actions`. Groups use action names from the exact clause. A selected action must satisfy its own `parameters.conditions` entry and all matching groups. These tests use the standard action failure path before preflight and effects. A listed unknown action name fails planning.

An optional connection `profile` points to `parameters.connectionProfiles` for shared `params` and `when`. A connection using a profile declares its own source and its other supported fields. A local `params` or `when` conflicts with using a profile. The connection's `when` can skip its trigger. An action guard rejects a selected invocation when false.

An optional group `inputs` object supplies literal configuration to that group's condition as `conditionInputs`. Each matching condition is evaluated in its own input scope. A typed group can inherit its condition from the referenced exact type and supply different input paths for this document. The existing per-action guard still runs before action preflight and effects.
